gifts.title: Tell customers the back room is bookable
gifts.for_complaint: Didn't know the back party/meeting room existed until visiting
gifts.deliverable: One-page printable flyer/table-tent, copy built entirely from their own customers' words (the small-group meetings, baby showers, quiche-and-coffee gatherings, the 'sofa side room') announcing the room is open to book, with a call-to-reserve line.
gifts.inputs_needed: Store phone number and hours from greatharvest.com/locations/wichitaks (public, reachable) to print on the call-to-book line; no capacity or pricing invented since we don't have it.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It quotes their own regulars back at them — free promotion for a room that already exists and already gets used, with zero copywriting left for the owner to do.

gifts.title: A fill-in-the-blank price sign for the bread case
gifts.for_complaint: No prices posted on baked goods, and price sticker-shock at checkout
gifts.deliverable: Printable price-sign template pre-formatted with every product customers name by name in the reviews (Cinnamon Burst, cinnamon rolls, sourdough, Dakota, Swedish rye, challah, stuffing bread, power bars, scones, bierocks, king cake) with blank price lines to write in same-day, sized for the case and register.
gifts.inputs_needed: None to build the template. Filling in numbers needs only the store's own current prices — a five-minute in-store task, no outside data.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It answers, almost verbatim, a customer's own written request — 'you need to post your prices with your baked items' — and heads off the recurring 'charged more than expected, keep your receipt' complaint in one printout.

gifts.title: A gluten-free and allergen guide built from their own reviews
gifts.for_complaint: Limited gluten-free options / no ingredient-allergen breakdown
gifts.deliverable: One-page printable guide listing the gluten-free items their own customers have praised by name across six years of reviews (GF buckwheat bread, GF almond cookies, GF blueberry muffins, GF pumpkin snickerdoodle), plus blank rows for staff to note allergens per item, for the counter or to hand to anyone who asks.
gifts.inputs_needed: None — every item is sourced from the collected reviews. Allergen specifics need staff's own recipe knowledge, filled in once.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: A customer walked out for good in 2018 because nobody could answer an allergen question; this hands the counter staff the exact answer instead of a shrug, using a list of their own best-loved GF items they may not realize is this long.
